bear_case: BTC Day 1 stop re-triggered on June 21 UTC close ($63,313) is the night's central risk development. The sell-off pattern — from morning's apparent safety ($64,460 at 11am UTC) to close at $63,313 — demonstrates that the US afternoon session (14:00-20:00 UTC) is the framework's structural vulnerability window. June 22 UTC is recovering strongly ($64,520 at 2:16am UTC), but the exact same window (US afternoon, 14:00-20:00 UTC) could deliver a Day 2 close below $63,500 if institutional sellers are not done. The bear case for the week: (1) IBIT shows resumed outflows on June 22 (institutional selling reversal was a single-day anomaly); (2) DXY reverses from the weekend decline back toward 101+ on Monday US session (hawkish Fed speaker, stronger-than-expected manufacturing PMI); (3) BTC June 22 UTC afternoon session mirrors June 21, delivering a second consecutive close below $63,500 → stop executes → full exit. Under the bear scenario: BTC exits at market on the June 22 UTC close (8pm ET Monday); NVDA conditional add is postponed indefinitely (DXY gate + BTC risk-on signal both closed); SPCX IG ratings are priced but the gap-up doesn't hold; SK Hynix faces a gap-down on June 23 KOSPI if Micron consensus of $34.66B turns out to be too high. The dual-catalyst setup (NVDA Annual Meeting + Micron Q3 on June 24) becomes a two-way event rather than a high-conviction long. Invalidation of the bear case: BTC June 22 UTC closes above $63,500 AND IBIT shows net inflows AND DXY closes below 100.00 on June 22 → all three gates clear simultaneously → upgrade from HOLD to BUY across the full watchlist.
